recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a person in dark clothing and sunglasses, framed against a textured industrial wall. The composition is split vertically between deep shadows on the left and a pale, textured green surface on the right featuring vertically stacked stencil-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark silhouette against a stark, diagonal light beam
Textured industrial wall acting as a canvas for the typography
Vertical alignment of text mirroring the verticality of the wall edge
Muted, desaturated color palette emphasizing mood over vibrancy
coreInvariants: Deep, crushed blacks in the subject's clothing and hair
A single, strong diagonal light source in the background
Textured, painted concrete or metal surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, positioned in a three-quarter view looking toward the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the subject's face, down the diagonal light beam, and then across to the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of deep shadow on the left and flat, textured wall space on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout with extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Stencil-style cuts in the middle of vertical and horizontal strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: O is split into two vertical halves
M and W have central breaks

composition.relationshipToImage: Printed directly onto the background texture

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varied tracking and line breaks.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic industrial stencil look with clean breaks.
Provides a modern, geometric take on the stencil aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A moody, low-key portrait of a person with long dark hair and sunglasses, wearing a black leather jacket. They are leaning against a pale, textured sage-green industrial wall. To the left, a dark alleyway with a single bright diagonal light beam cutting through the darkness.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical, center-aligned stencil-style text on the right-hand wall section. The text should be black, uppercase, and condensed, with one word per line.

verificationChecks: Does the font have visible stencil gaps?
Is the lighting high-contrast and low-key?
Is the color palette muted and industrial?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the diagonal light beam
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subject
Original artist name or album title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text looks integrated into the wall texture.
Check that the diagonal light beam doesn't wash out the subject.
Verify the stencil gaps are consistent across all letters.
Confirm the vertical alignment of the text block.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key urban portrait with a textured vertical canvas for stencil-based typography to create a 90s-inspired industrial aesthetic.
